svg.title: The energy balance and the heater's step response
svg.desc: After the command steps from 75 to 85 percent, the measured temperature follows the calculated curve 35 + 2(1 − e^(−(t−1)/5)): no change for 1 second, then 0.4 degrees Celsius per second, 36.264 degrees at 6 seconds and nearly 37 degrees at 30 seconds. The heater power jumps to 170 kilowatts at 1 second while the heat loss grows from 150 to 169.87 kilowatts.
svg.text: The energy balance predicts the heater's step response
Control Studio recording of this project · command 75 → 85 % at 0 s · numbers answer the predictions
At 1 s the heater gives 170 kW, the loss is still 150 kW
At 26 s the loss has grown to 169.87 kW
